locked.rule: Per target family, the inputs and settings with the highest mean skill on June (fit March-May); within 0.005 of the best, the simplest (fewer inputs, then fewer leaves, then fewer trees). Bands: the calibration with the smallest mean |coverage - 0.90| on July (fit March-May, calibrate June); within 0.005, the simplest.
